description: This is a shell script file, specifically a test script for Git clone options covering various test cases and validations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success; runs the provided commands and reports if they succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail; used to verify proper error handling.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets a global git configuration for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_cmp_config
methods.description: Compares the expected and actual git configuration values.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file or output, verifying its presence.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test finishes.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a directory or file does not exist.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Runs a test command and reports success or failure.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit in the specified directory.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
